surviving_claim.plain_language: For two explicit quantum-compilation grammar families, a whole-instance deletion contract yields exact support normal forms, and the same rank-only certificate language can be exact for one family but loose for another because it omits a whole-system transformation.
surviving_claim.posterior_change: A support ceiling is not automatically intrinsic: compiler semantics and objective preservation must be proved, and a separate lower witness or omitted transformation determines whether the certificate language is sharp.
